problem.description: The actual Candidates read callback kept an unconfirmed selection after a refreshed list already showed SELECTED; no authoritative command receipt was read.

implementation: Add a narrowly granted STABLE reader over existing private.selection_commands, exact owner/key/hash/payload and current Agreement ownership/link.
Require real JWT session_id and the existing captured session guard; deny missing, malformed, revoked, expired, foreign session and deleted or banned account.
Retain existing closure authority and authorized minimal cooperation history after block or partner closure; no new message, location, contact or media access.
Resolve the receipt before incidental candidate or task reads. A changed revision or unavailable list cannot hide the committed selection.
Preserve the immutable unknown intent; NOT_FOUND offers separate read-again and explicit same-key retry actions.
Settle a selection refusal only when current writer error and SQLSTATE both match; last-place refusal opens current applications.
Present recovered terminal Agreement state without a fresh-cooperation celebration or stale capacity count.
Keep recovered view during refresh, fence account/focus/generation changes, and do not mark an in-flight list read as a receipt check.
Use formal Serbian copy in touched selection presentations and adapter messages.

remaining: DEV exact migration and the existing terminal TEST Agreement receipt are confirmed with ordinary Auth. Live revoked-session mutations were not performed; denial is proven by the local captured-helper SQL cases. Native recovery remains untested.
Pending selection remains memory-only; cold restart recovery is not completed by this patch.
True last-place concurrency needs a requester and two independent authorized TEST workers; two existing accounts are not sufficient proof.
Blocked/closing cancellation reason remains NOT_KEPT under the existing contract; no unauthorized audit/message path or retention policy was invented.
CI, APK/native acceptance and production readiness are not confirmed by these local tests.
